scope: Official documentation and selected public source inspection only; no execution/playback certification

observations.subject: Plugin loader and API injection
observations.finding: Manifest/entry loading and new Function evaluation with host APIs; do not reproduce arbitrary plugin execution in MVP

observations.subject: Metadata and two-phase streaming
observations.finding: Provider-scoped metadata, V1/V2 candidate discovery and resolution, expiry/attempts, ordered candidate fallback, stale-result guards

observations.subject: Native host and media transport
observations.finding: Tauri native executable invocation and loopback media proxy with ranges/CORS; not ordinary browser capabilities

observations.subject: Audio engine
observations.finding: HTML audio with specialized HLS/MSE hooks; snapshots differ in signatures; internal MSE controller not fully recovered

observations.subject: Browser media access
observations.finding: Separate metadata fetch, direct playback and DSP byte access; File objects are selected references

observations.subject: YouTube official player
observations.finding: Documented known-ID browser embed, clock/state/control API; visible-player/ads/no extraction restrictions; no Lumaire test run

observations.subject: SoundCloud
observations.finding: Widget controls documented; paid custom registration and aggregation terms keep Lumaire inclusion conditional

observations.subject: Other catalogues
observations.finding: Jamendo credential interpretation still open; Audius terms retrieval failed; Spotify Premium requirement documented

observations.subject: Deployment/helper
observations.finding: Static site and finite host limits distinct from backend; helper local-network permissions require browser tests

observations.subject: Software rights
observations.finding: AGPL applies to inspected Nuclear repository/SDK; no code imported; separate yt-dlp/content rights
